overview: Tag is a compact, non-interactive label for a status or category.

default.title: Default
default.text: The default appearance keeps the existing Tag colors and geometry.

highlight.title: Highlight
highlight.text: Highlight emphasizes a short label with its stronger type treatment.

translucent.title: Translucent
translucent.text: Translucent uses a token color at 24% opacity. Translucent with dark text (`neutral-02`) is for light colored surfaces. The white-text types (`positive`, `warning`, `negative`, `complementary`, `neutral`) are for strong colored surfaces. Translucent exists only in medium size with an icon. Do not use it on white backgrounds.

api.intro: Tag renders a concise label as static content. Use its controls to choose an appearance, type, size, and icon.
api.appearance: Visual treatment for the default variant. `default` preserves the standard appearance; Translucent uses the type's background token at 24% opacity. Translucent with dark text (`neutral-02`) is for light colored surfaces. The white-text types (`positive`, `warning`, `negative`, `complementary`, `neutral`) are for strong colored surfaces. Translucent exists only in medium size with an icon. Highlight does not accept this prop. Do not use it on white backgrounds.
api.children: Text content displayed by the Tag.
api.className: Additional class name applied to the Tag root.
api.icon: Optional custom React element used as the Tag icon.
api.size: Tag size. Translucent appearance uses medium size.
api.type: Status or category color and icon style for the Tag.
api.variant: Tag type treatment: default or highlight.

tokens.intro: The table below lists the Ocean tokens used by the Tag styles.

size.title: Size
size.text: Choose small for dense layouts or medium for the standard Tag size.

icon.title: Custom icon
icon.text: Pass a React element to `icon` when the default icon does not express the intended meaning.

setIconOff.title: Hide the icon
setIconOff.text: Set `setIconOff` to hide the default icon.

rules: Keep the label concise and understandable without color alone.

Translucent with dark text (`neutral-02`) is for light colored surfaces. The white-text types (`positive`, `warning`, `negative`, `complementary`, `neutral`) are for strong colored surfaces. Translucent exists only in medium size with an icon; neutral, neutral-02 and complementary need a custom `icon`.
Use Translucent only on colored surfaces, never on white backgrounds.
The Tag label is plain text and is not a keyboard focus target.
When `setIconOff` is true, the default icon is not rendered.
